name: ppip_valve_chute
description: TTAN-walled vertical chute: a central PPIP riser flanked by two PVOD drain columns and a FILT collector.
why: Build-lessons pattern (valve/portal bay): PPIP is a poweredp pipe segment (valve) that defaults closed; pairing it with PVOD drain columns on each side and a FILT/HSWC collector strip at the bottom gives a chute that can carry, valve and finally void-drain a fluid column without touching the surrounding structure.
source: save2, valve/portal bay x224-300 y296-336 (PPIP+PVOD columns, FILT/HSWC/WIFI collector y324-333)
